Deduction assessment
Customer reports receiving 380 of 400 cases of Citrus Sparkling Water, SKU NS-100, billed at $30.00 per case. Twenty cases were deducted.
Original invoice: $12,000.00
Deduction: $600.00
Net remitted: $11,400.00
Calculation: 20 cases x $30.00 = $600.00
Customer-stated basis: Receiving report RR-HLM-442 records 380 cases. Carrier delivery reference POD-442 is cited by the customer.
Supporting records requested for review: Signed proof of delivery, bill of lading, warehouse pick record, and customer receiving report.
Claim status and response reference: Open - deducted from payment; supplier review pending. Reference DN-2609-001, INV-260801, and RA-2609-001 in any dispute response. Supporting records are referenced for testing and are not included in this sample.
